summary.causeComparedWithSource: The live bundle is not stale: it contains the Member Group Cards shrinkOwningSectionRelay opt-in and the relay implementation. Responsive behavior confirms signed relay on mobile (following content moves up by the same 2248.19px as the card shrink) and growth relay on tablet (+52px). At desktop the 15-card live grid is 838.02px shorter than its saved card box, but the owning Section remains at its authored 2248px height; collision protection therefore preserves the authored 368px Section-to-following gap, leaving 918.02px from cards to following content. The remaining desktop space is caused by the saved/effective owning Section boundary, not by a missing deployed member-group-cards flag.
